limits: Actual static mutex create/take/release and TLSF create/malloc/free/reallocate, common original filesystem peers.
Constructed clean/error-marked file with caller-owned cache; no media I/O, dirty flush, pending waiters, live scheduling or callback concurrency.
Heap mutex rejection stops before error logger first instruction; no successful free or fabricated return.
Backend error return/free ordering is static source evidence, not injected backend failure.
